nameOrigin: edible nut in a spiky shell

pokedexEntries.x: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.

pokedexEntries.or: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.

pokedexEntries.y: Such a thick shell of wood covers its head and back that even a direct hit from a truck wouldn’t faze it.

pokedexEntries.as: Such a thick shell of wood covers its head and back that even a direct hit from a truck wouldn’t faze it.

pokedexEntries.sc: When Chespin tenses up just before landing a headbutt, the spikes on its head sharpen to points, piercing the enemy’s body on contact.

pokedexEntries.vi: Eating lots of berries makes the bark shell that covers Chespin’s head and body grow sturdier.
